'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Michael Richards LS Center Of Tyranny''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Richards|Michael Richards]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

This list is written on notebook paper rather than the deck form. It is transcribed as written: the sheet has 61 written main-deck lines, one of which is struck through, so 60 live lines plus 12 shields.

'''Transcription notes''' (left for later cleanup): Line 6 written ''Anger, Fear Aggression'': written without a (V) mark; version not confirmed; Line 8 written ''Coruscant v'': (V) mark; version not confirmed; Line 9 written ''Planetary Shield'': not identified; Line 12 written ''Pressel'': not identified; Line 15 written ''Hoth: x'': not identified; Line 17 written ''Escape Pod v'': (V) mark; version not confirmed; Line 18 written ''Obi in Ship'': not expanded; Line 19 written ''Wes Janson, Rogue'': not expanded; Line 24 written ''Escape Pod v'': (V) mark; version not confirmed; Line 25 written ''Luke Skywalker, Rebel Hero'': not confirmed; Line 26 written ''"'': ditto of Luke Skywalker, Rebel Hero; Line 27 written ''"'': ditto of Luke Skywalker, Rebel Hero; Line 29 written ''Leia v'': bare Leia with (V) mark; card not identified; Line 30 written ''Wedge Antilles, Legendary'': not confirmed; Line 31 written ''Yub Yub Commander'': not confirmed; Line 32 written ''"'': ditto; Line 33 written ''"'': ditto; Line 34 written ''"'': ditto; Line 36 written ''Dark Rattler v'': not confirmed; Line 37 written ''We wish to Board v'': (V) mark; version not confirmed; Line 38 written ''It could be worse'': not confirmed; Line 39 written ''Biggs Rogue Legend'': not confirmed; Line 40 written ''Command Training & K'lor'slug'': not confirmed; Line 44 written ''Derek Klivian v'' (V): no Light Side wiki page found for Derek Klivian (V); Line 45 written ''Wedge Antilles, RSL'': not expanded; Line 46 written ''Veteran Rogue'': not confirmed; Line 48 written ''Han, Chewie, And the Falcon v'' (V): no Light Side wiki page found for Han, Chewie And The Falcon (V); Line 49 written ''"'' (V): no Light Side wiki page found for Han, Chewie And The Falcon (V); Line 52 written ''Commander Wurra'': not confirmed; Line 54 written ''We wish to Board'': not confirmed; Line 55 written ''Kyle's Blaster Pistol v'' (V): no Light Side wiki page found for Kyle's Blaster Pistol (V); Line 56 written ''Meneda Fades'': not identified; Line 57 written ''Odn Nesbor & First Aid'': not identified; Line 60 written ''Veteran Rogue'': not confirmed; Line 61 ''(struck line)'': struck through on the sheet; Shield 7 written ''Simple Trix'': not expanded; Shield 9 written ''Do Or Do Not'': not confirmed. Lines in italics are as written on the sheet and are not linked because the card or its version could not be identified for certain.
